templates.description: A standard symphonic setup with one track per part: the staff and its Producer track switch articulations through the articulation map. The lightest way to work; expand any part later.
templates.treatment: Pairs of woodwinds, four horns, three trumpets, three trombones and tuba, timpani, harp and a five-part string section, seated and panned as on a scoring stage.

templates.description: A standard symphonic setup with each part's articulations on tracks of their own (Violins I - Staccato, - Pizzicato...): one staff per part in Composer, a track per sound in Producer for editing, mixing and stems. Uses more memory.
templates.treatment: Pairs of woodwinds, four horns, three trumpets, three trombones and tuba, timpani, harp and a five-part string section, seated and panned as on a scoring stage.

templates.display_name: Full Orchestra — Every Articulation on Its Own Track
templates.description: The whole orchestra with every articulation on a track of its own: Violins I - Legato, - Staccato, - Spiccato, - Pizzicato, - Tremolo, - Harmonics, - Con sordino and the rest, and likewise for every woodwind, brass, percussion, keyboard and choir part. Each track takes the sound you assigned for that instrument and articulation in Window > Library > Sound Assignments. One staff per part in Composer. A very large template: Freeze & Unload what you are not using.
templates.treatment: Piccolo, flutes, oboes, English horn, clarinets, bass clarinet, bassoons, contrabassoon; horns, trumpets, trombones, bass trombone, tuba; timpani, snare, bass drum, cymbals, glockenspiel, xylophone; harp, celesta, piano; SATB choir; five-part strings.
